samples.question: Five panels are stacked vertically and read top to bottom. Every panel shows the same horizontal track divided into six slots. Three tokens - one red, one green, one blue - each keep their own fixed colour and sit in one slot of every panel; at most one token occupies any single slot. A token's HOLD STREAK is the longest run of consecutive panels in which it stays in the same slot (its disk does not move sideways between those panels). Which token has the LONGEST hold streak across the five panels? Answer 'red', 'green', or 'blue'.
